If sentiment is negative in the last 3 days, reduce forecast by 1.5–2.5% in early horizon (1–7 days) to avoid over-optimism.  
If sentiment is positive and forecast is trending up, cap upward movement at +1.0% in mid horizon (8–15 days) to prevent overshoot.  
If sentiment is neutral and forecast is below historical mean, add 0.5–1.0% to forecast in late horizon (16–30 days) to correct downward bias.  
If sentiment is negative and forecast is above 70.0, reduce by 2.0–3.0% in late horizon to align with bearish momentum.  
If sentiment is positive and forecast is below 70.0, increase by 0.5–1.5% in early horizon to capture bullish momentum.  
If sentiment is neutral and forecast is trending flat, adjust by +0.3% per day in late horizon to avoid stagnation bias.
